packages.rationale: GRADUATED 2026-08-13, two days ahead of the raise-by date. Measured coverage (95.4 statements / 88.4 branches / 89.4 functions / 97.1 lines) was already well clear of the 85/80/85/85 identity floor, so the floor was raised to the commitment without new tests — the named service-layer error paths (register-with-relay 4xx/5xx, bootstrap re-entry) had been covered by work landing after the 2026-06 snapshot was taken, and nobody re-measured. `branches` is held at 86, above its target of 80: a graduation target is a floor to reach, never a level to fall back to, and lowering a live threshold to match one would violate the never-lower-thresholds policy. Retained as a closed record rather than deleted so the commitment and its outcome stay auditable.

RE-BASELINED 2026-08-22 (#568). The previous entry (90/75/100/90 -> branches 80 by 09-30) described a measurement that did not exist: src/cli.ts sat in coverageExclude as "the bin shim", so the thresholds were enforced against 8 statements in adapters.ts -- 2.3% of the package -- while the stated lever was "the CLI's unsupported-suite / post-quantum-pending branches", which live in the excluded file. The lever could not move the number because there was effectively no number. (The thresholds themselves were real, not vacuous: a deliberate severing fails them. #568's "measures zero files" reading came from the empty text-reporter table, the same artifact that caused the #575/#576 revert -- coverage-final.json always had adapters.ts at 100%.) cli.ts is now measured, and 45 in-process parseArgs branch tests took the package from 39.4/32.4/47.4/39.8 to 60/51.7/47.4/58.1. The floor is set just under that. Digits are lower than the old 90/75/100/90 but enforcement is 43x wider: 345 statements guarded instead of 8, and adapters.ts keeps a per-glob 100/100/100/100 floor so nothing regressed. Target is the registry's identity floor. Lever: the remaining gap is the command bodies (cli.ts ~640-1012, and the 10 uncovered functions), which the existing suite drives through spawnSync -- real end-to-end verification the parent process cannot instrument. Extract a runCli(argv) seam so those tests execute in-process and their coverage counts. Date moved 09-30 -> 11-30 because that is a refactor of the CLI's entry seam plus five test files, not the fixture pass the old rationale assumed; re-baselining on new information rather than quietly missing the date.
